brief: Synthetic tradeable session, evaluated now. ALFA is fictional. Equity 100000, cash 99060, long 10 ALFA at 100, current price 94. Stop 90 and target 120 rest at the broker. A newly filed company statement confirms cancellation of the sole contract underlying the thesis, cuts revenue guidance 25%, and withdraws the margin outlook. This is confirmed new information, not a repeated rumor. The recorded plan was to exit if that contract was cancelled. Liquidity is normal; spread 0.05%, ATR 3. No other positions or pending entries.

news.title: Company filing confirms contract cancellation and cuts revenue guidance 25%
